source: Pink Tiger on the Wharf official PDF menu

items.name: Korean Chicken Wings
items.description: Crispy fried wings and drums with spicy gochujang sauce.

items.name: Ahi Tuna Nachos

items.name: Fried Dumplings

items.name: Deviled Eggs

items.name: Mango & Avocado Salad

items.description: Roasted chicken with soy-lemongrass reduction, candied five-spice carrots, and edamame pomme puree.

items.description: Shrimp with spicy red curry, garlic, carrots, bell peppers, bamboo shoots, eggplant, and jasmine rice.

items.name: Wood Grilled Salmon
items.description: Seven-ounce salmon with sweet ginger glaze, lime, garlic, and pan roasted vegetables.

items.name: Green Curry with Mussels
items.description: Mussels with creamy coconut lime broth, fresh herbs, and grilled ciabatta bread.

items.name: Crispy Red Snapper
items.description: Fried whole fish with soy-ginger sauce, leeks, and baby bok choy.

items.name: Gochujang Short Ribs
items.description: Slow-braised boneless short ribs with maple gochujang lacquer, roasted carrots, and polenta.

items.name: Joe's Smash Burger

items.name: Hot Stone
items.description: Choice of premium meat sliced for searing on a 700 degree hot stone with baked potato stuffed with butter, sour cream, citrus slaw, scallions, and shredded cheddar.

items.name: Spicy Thai Style Whole Fish
